mapper.select:
select member.car_num AS "car_num", car.car_stat AS "car_stat", space.floor AS "floor", car.spc_no AS "spcNo", car.ent_time AS "ent_time", car.discnt_at AS "discnt_at"
from member
join car ON member.id = car.id
left join space ON car.spc_no = space.spc_no
where member.car_num like '%' || #{car_num} || '%' and car.car_stat IN (0, 1, 3)
order by car.ent_time DESC
